evidence: Workbook row 12 (Quality Checks r13): "[environment].docker_image isn't set while the agent Dockerfile still has active build steps (which would skip the Dockerfile entirely)." Skill quality-checks.md section 12 and staged-task-contract.md:78 say the same. Frozen task/task.toml [environment] block (lines 20-24) holds only build_timeout_sec = 600.0, network_mode = "public", cpus = 2, memory_mb = 4096. A recursive grep for 'docker_image' and 'image =' across task/ and the template finds nothing, and no section header besides [task],[metadata],[agent],[environment],[verifier],[verifier.env],[verifier.environment] exists. The [environment] block is identical to the template's task.toml. task/environment/Dockerfile has active build steps (FROM node:22-bookworm-slim; RUN apt-get install ca-certificates git procps sqlite3; RUN npm install -g express@5.1.0 better-sqlite3@12.4.1; COPY instructions/ and assets/; git init /app). It is byte-identical to the template Dockerfile (both sha256 0a75419e...). Because no prebuilt image is declared, the agent image is built from this Dockerfile, so /instructions, /assets and the pinned globals the brief depends on are present. Adversarial check: a docker_image line in [environment] would bypass these COPY steps and leave /instructions and /assets missing. The frozen bytes have no such line. The Colderwater lessons (brief realism, judge timing, restart and double-grading) have no pattern that bears on this row. The row is static config, so no runtime evidence is needed. The Pass does not claim any Oracle, portal or model result.
